name: Attribute Quantization
definition: A lossy compression technique that reduces attribute precision (colors and normals) to lower memory footprint while maintaining perceptual quality, assessed using CIE94 delta-E and SSIM metrics.
summary: Attribute Quantization is a lossy compression technique that reduces voxel attribute precision using perceptual strategies like CIELAB color clustering and Octahedron Normal Vectors to lower memory usage while maintaining visual quality.
